profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 14+ years of experience designing, modernizing, and building scalable enterprise applications and business-critical systems from the ground up. Strong background across backend architecture, frontend development, APIs, cloud platforms, and database design, with deep experience in C#, .NET, Angular, TypeScript, SQL, relational database design, and modern tech stacks.

Experienced across the full application lifecycle, from architecture and hands-on development through deployment, modernization, production support, and long-term platform evolution. Known for modernizing legacy systems, improving scalability and maintainability, and delivering high-impact solutions across enterprise environments.

Skilled in designing and integrating RESTful APIs, cloud-based applications, CI/CD pipelines, and scalable full-stack platforms using .NET Core, Angular, Node.js, Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, and Azure DevOps.

Drawn to complex technical challenges, clean and maintainable systems, developer mentorship, and software that delivers meaningful business impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked across frontend and backend development, automation, and enterprise business systems, taking ownership of internal tools and technical initiatives while supporting application reliability and long-term platform growth.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and built a full-stack enterprise application from the ground up using .NET Core and Angular to support technician workflows, operational efficiency, and internal business processes. Led architecture, development, API integration, database design, and ongoing platform enhancements.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Built and owned a business-critical system from scratch, defining the architecture and turning complex operational processes into reliable software used to support day-to-day operations. Set technical direction, drove delivery, and led development while mentoring engineers.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description: Contributed to the GoGoMeds platform through ongoing feature development, Angular version upgrades, and platform improvements. Later led development efforts for the Maryland State Police Professional Licensing Unit (PLU) portal, redesigning and building full-stack solutions focused on long-term stability, maintainability, and continued platform growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Helped a team consisting mostly of senior developers on various tasks involved with both front-end and back-end development.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: Responsible for managing principal sponsor applications which were entered within the (new development) web based software application
